papers.abstract_original: Employees with disability-related communication impairment often experience isolation from professional connections that can negatively affect their careers. Management research suggests that having lower quality leader relationships can be an obstacle to the development of professional connections for employees with disabilities. However, in this paper we suggest that lower quality leader–member exchange (LMX) relationships may not be a uniform hurdle for the professional isolation of employees with disability-related communication impairment. Drawing on psychological disengagement theory, we predict that employees with more severe, rather than less severe, communication impairment develop resilience to challenges in lower quality LMX relationships by psychologically disengaging from professional connections and, in turn, bear fewer negative consequences of professional isolation on career outcomes. In two studies of deaf and hard of hearing employees, we find that in lower quality LMX relationships employees with more severe communication impairment perceive being less isolated than employees with less severe communication impairment, and, in turn, report better career outcomes. Overall, our findings suggest that employees with more severe communication impairment may develop effective coping strategies to manage challenges of perceived professional isolation for career outcomes when in lower quality LMX relationships.
papers.abstract_zh: 有残疾相关沟通障碍的员工常常经历与职业联系的隔离，这可能对其职业生涯产生负面影响。管理研究表明，拥有较低质量的领导关系可能成为残疾员工发展职业联系的障碍。然而，在本文中，我们认为较低质量的领导—成员交换（LMX）关系可能并非残疾相关沟通障碍员工职业孤立的统一障碍。借鉴心理脱离理论，我们预测，沟通障碍更严重（而非较轻）的员工通过心理上脱离职业联系，对较低质量LMX关系中的挑战产生韧性，进而承受职业孤立对职业结果的较少负面后果。在两项针对聋人和重听员工的研究中，我们发现，在较低质量的LMX关系中，沟通障碍更严重的员工比沟通障碍较轻的员工感知到的孤立更少，进而报告更好的职业结果。总体而言，我们的发现表明，沟通障碍更严重的员工在较低质量LMX关系中可能发展出有效的应对策略，以管理感知到的职业孤立对职业结果的挑战。

papers.abstract_original: An important challenge faced by women CEOs is that their firms tend to receive more shareholder activism than firms with men CEOs. Frequently, this activism represents attempts by shareholders to direct or override the decisions made by the firms’ leaders. The current paper integrates micro and macro perspectives to explore the factors influencing gender differences in shareholder activism. Drawing on social psychology research, we examine gender role expectations and perceived lack of fit as underlying psychological mechanisms, and we use industry gender type (i.e., men- or women-dominated industry) as an important structural factor that shapes the effects of these psychological mechanisms and women CEOs’ propensity to be targeted by shareholder activism. We test the hypotheses using archival data of shareholder activism at S&P 1500 companies. We also use two vignette-based experiments to examine the underlying mechanisms for why CEO gender relates to shareholder activism differently across industries. Implications and directions for future research are discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 女性CEO面临的一个重要挑战是，她们所在的公司往往比男性CEO所在的公司受到更多股东行动主义。通常，这种行动主义代表股东试图指导或推翻公司领导人的决策。本文整合微观和宏观视角，探讨影响股东行动主义中性别差异的因素。借鉴社会心理学研究，我们考察性别角色期望和感知的不匹配作为潜在心理机制，并使用行业性别类型（即男性主导或女性主导行业）作为塑造这些心理机制效应以及女性CEO被股东行动主义针对倾向的重要结构因素。我们使用标普1500家公司的股东行动主义档案数据检验假设。我们还使用两个基于情境的实验来考察CEO性别为何在不同行业中与股东行动主义存在不同关联的潜在机制。文中讨论了启示和未来研究方向。

papers.abstract_original: While the corporate lingua franca mandate aims to facilitate communications among linguistically diverse employees, evidence shows that it creates more problems than it solves, often negatively affecting social integration and knowledge sharing in the workplace. Our study is driven by the phenomenon of high language diversity and low lingua franca proficiency, emerging characteristics of workplaces around the globe given increasing migration. We adopt a mixed-methods, longitudinal design involving participant observations, interviews, social network surveys, and company data. Our analysis revealed the existence and prevalence of an informal language advice network (LAN) in which individuals with varying levels of English proficiency actively engage in voluntary language-related knowledge-seeking and sharing. We found more positive interpersonal interactions and consequences of LAN than typically reported in extant studies. We leverage the social networks and generalized exchange literature to explain the processes and consequences of LAN for individuals and the organization. Management recognition was found to be important for sustaining LAN in a context of high language diversity. Our integrative analytical framework offers a valuable lens for scholarship on future workplaces that are being shaped by rapidly shifting ethnic, cultural, and linguistic demography.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管企业通用语指令旨在促进语言多样化员工之间的沟通，但证据表明，它造成的问题比解决的问题更多，往往对工作场所的社会融合和知识共享产生负面影响。我们的研究由高语言多样性和低通用语熟练度这一现象所驱动，鉴于移民不断增加，这正成为全球各地工作场所的新兴特征。我们采用混合方法的纵向设计，包括参与式观察、访谈、社会网络调查和公司数据。我们的分析揭示了非正式语言建议网络（LAN）的存在和普遍性，在该网络中，英语熟练程度各异的个人积极参与自愿的语言相关知识的寻求与分享。我们发现LAN的人际互动及其后果比现有研究中通常报告的更为积极。我们借助社会网络和广义交换文献来解释LAN对个人和组织的过程与后果。研究发现，管理层的认可对于在高语言多样性情境下维持LAN至关重要。我们的整合性分析框架为研究由快速变化的族裔、文化和语言人口结构所塑造的未来工作场所提供了有价值的视角。

papers.abstract_original: Strategy research usually assumes that displays of weakness are disadvantageous for firms. In this study, we challenge this assumption. We propose that deliberate displays of weakness can help firms preserve stakeholder approval when taking controversial decisions. To test this proposition, we examine the use and effectiveness of organizational supplication in the context of workforce downsizing. Building on impression management theory, we predict that firms portray themselves as weak through downward earnings management before workforce downsizing announcements, and that this supplication tactic helps attenuate investors’ negative reactions. Moreover, we posit that supplication paired with an efficiency-focused verbal justification for the downsizing is particularly effective at attenuating negative investor reactions to downsizing announcements, as an additional verbal justification lends authenticity to the downsizing firm’s supplication attempt. Yet, we also theorize that organizational supplication through downward earnings management is less effective if positive firm evaluations by security analysts and the business media make it appear inauthentic. The empirical analysis of nearly 600 workforce downsizing announcements by the largest listed U.S. firms between 2001 and 2020 supports our theoretical predictions.
papers.abstract_zh: 战略研究通常假定，展示弱点对企业不利。在本研究中，我们挑战这一假设。我们提出，刻意展示弱点可以帮助企业在做出有争议的决策时维持利益相关者的认可。为检验这一命题，我们考察组织恳求在劳动力裁员情境中的使用及其有效性。基于印象管理理论，我们预测企业会在劳动力裁员公告之前通过向下盈余管理将自己描绘为弱势，并且这种恳求策略有助于减弱投资者的负面反应。此外，我们假定，将恳求与以效率为重点的裁员口头辩解相结合，对于减弱投资者对裁员公告的负面反应尤为有效，因为额外的口头辩解为裁员企业的恳求尝试增添了真实性。然而，我们还从理论上提出，如果证券分析师和商业媒体对企业的正面评价使通过向下盈余管理进行的组织恳求显得不真实，那么这种恳求的效果会较差。对2001年至2020年间美国最大上市公司近600次劳动力裁员公告的实证分析支持了我们的理论预测。

papers.abstract_original: Research on psychological resilience in the workplace is on the rise, aiming to better understand how to successfully manage adverse events. Although scholars have started to explore the concept of team resilience, the focus of the theory on team resilience has been largely on cognitive mechanisms. However, neglecting the role of relational mechanisms discounts the collaboration and social interaction that are necessary for successful teamwork, especially in the face of adverse events. To address this research gap, we conducted a qualitative study with a palliative care team that experienced work-related adverse events. Based on our data and applying conservation of resources theory, we develop a process model of team resilience. This model specifies the experience of adverse events as loss events and illustrates how teams can counteract these losses and enact team resilience through the relational process of caring. Caring in teams can be enacted through four dimensions, which we refer to as understanding, being with, doing for, and enabling. By enacting these caring dimensions, teams can heal social safety and collective action capabilities and can moreover build valuable resources, which may buffer resource loss and fuel resource growth in subsequent team resilience episodes. Our findings provide a better understanding of the role of relational processes in team resilience enactment and specify caring as a core relational mechanism that enables team resilient outcomes. Overall, we provide a nuanced understanding of the different elements within a team resilience process.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于工作场所中心理韧性的研究正在增加，旨在更好地理解如何成功应对不利事件。尽管学者们已开始探索团队韧性的概念，但关于团队韧性的理论重点在很大程度上仍集中在认知机制上。然而，忽视关系机制的作用会低估成功团队合作所必需的协作与社会互动，尤其是在面对不利事件时。为弥补这一研究空白，我们对一个经历过工作相关不利事件的姑息治疗团队进行了定性研究。基于我们的数据并应用资源保存理论，我们构建了一个团队韧性过程模型。该模型将不利事件的经历界定为损失事件，并说明团队如何能够抵消这些损失，并通过关怀这一关系过程来实施团队韧性。团队中的关怀可以通过四个维度来实施，我们将其称为理解、陪伴、代为行动和赋能。通过实施这些关怀维度，团队可以修复社会安全感和集体行动能力，并且还能构建有价值的资源，这些资源可能缓冲资源损失，并在后续的团队韧性事件中推动资源增长。我们的发现更好地理解了关系过程在团队韧性实施中的作用，并将关怀明确为促成团队韧性结果的核心关系机制。总体而言，我们对团队韧性过程中的不同要素提供了更为细致的理解。

papers.abstract_original: Social comparison theory (SCT) is ubiquitous and underlies much of modern management research. However, in addition to comparing ourselves externally to similar others, educational and social psychologists study how internal comparisons affect children. Internal comparison theories (ICTs) fall into two categories that include (a) temporal comparisons, that is, comparisons between our current self-evaluation and a past or future evaluation; and (b) dimensional comparisons, that is, comparisons between our evaluation in one dimension (e.g., teaching skills) to our evaluation on another dimension (e.g., research skills). We compare tenets of ICTs and SCT and present novel theoretical propositions around these tenets, and show how they differentially impact affective, behavioral, and cognitive identity work. Additionally, we offer future directions for how theorizing could be expanded on core internal comparison theories, as well as how ICTs could be used as a theoretical framework for research on identity, stress and well-being, justice, leadership, emotions, and social hierarchy.
papers.abstract_zh: 社会比较理论（SCT）无处不在，并且构成了现代管理研究的诸多基础。然而，除了将我们自己与相似他人进行外部比较之外，教育心理学家和社会心理学家还研究内部比较如何影响儿童。内部比较理论（ICTs）分为两类，包括：（a）时间比较，即我们当前的自我评价与过去或未来评价之间的比较；以及（b）维度比较，即我们在一个维度上的评价（例如教学技能）与我们在另一个维度上的评价（例如研究技能）之间的比较。我们比较了内部比较理论与社会比较理论的核心命题，并围绕这些命题提出了新的理论主张，展示了它们如何以不同方式影响情感性、行为性和认知性的身份工作。此外，我们还提出了未来方向，说明如何围绕核心内部比较理论拓展理论化，以及如何将内部比较理论用作研究身份、压力与幸福感、公正、领导力、情绪和社会等级制的理论框架。

papers.abstract_original: Studies of organizational learning show that experience enables firms to utilize specific governance structures effectively. Nevertheless, little attention has been given to comparing the effects of learning-by-doing across different structures. In this paper we investigate whether the duration of operation influences performance differently in two structures utilized in public services: in-house provision and external contracting. An analysis of water supply data in France from 1998 to 2008 suggests that the learning advantages are greater in external contracting due to its high-powered incentives, but these benefits decrease as the technological complexity and environmental uncertainty of public services increase. We contribute to organizational learning theory, extend research on governance structures, and provide critical insights into the sustainable management of natural resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于组织学习的研究表明，经验使企业能够有效利用特定的治理结构。然而，鲜有研究关注比较不同结构下干中学的效果。本文研究运营时长是否对公共服务中采用的两种结构——内部提供和外部承包——的绩效产生不同影响。对法国1998年至2008年供水数据的分析表明，由于外部承包具有高能激励，其学习优势更大，但随着公共服务的技术复杂性和环境不确定性增加，这些收益会减少。我们为组织学习理论做出贡献，拓展了治理结构研究，并为自然资源的可持续管理提供了重要见解。

papers.abstract_original: Executive compensation is a key topic in management research, focusing on how firms use incentives to align CEOs’ decisions with shareholders’ interests. Yet, we know little about the influence of stock-option compensation—a major component of CEO pay—on CEO decisions facing adverse events involving multiple stakeholders. Analyzing U.S. medical device recalls between 2004 and 2017, we examine how stock options induce CEOs to protect their existing wealth while pursuing potential gains. We find that CEOs with greater current option wealth are more likely to adopt short-term impression management (IM) tactics, such as strategically timing recalls and maintaining silence in press releases, which can harm shareholders and stakeholders. In contrast, CEOs with higher prospective option wealth are less inclined to employ these tactics. Moreover, negative media scrutiny discourages CEOs with substantial current option wealth from using IM tactics, and encourages those with greater prospective option wealth to further avoid them. These findings highlight the powerful role of executive compensation, particularly stock options, in shaping CEO decisions facing adverse events.
papers.abstract_zh: 高管薪酬是管理研究中的一个关键主题，重点关注企业如何利用激励措施使CEO的决策与股东利益保持一致。然而，对于股票期权薪酬——CEO薪酬的一个主要组成部分——如何影响CEO在面对涉及多方利益相关者的不利事件时的决策，我们知之甚少。通过分析2004年至2017年间美国医疗器械召回事件，我们考察了股票期权如何促使CEO在追求潜在收益的同时保护其既有财富。我们发现，当前期权财富更高的CEO更可能采用短期印象管理（IM）策略，例如策略性地选择召回时机以及在新闻稿中保持沉默，这可能损害股东和利益相关者。相比之下，未来期权财富更高的CEO则不太倾向于采用这些策略。此外，负面媒体审视会抑制拥有大量当前期权财富的CEO使用印象管理策略，并促使拥有更高未来期权财富的CEO进一步避免这些策略。这些发现凸显了高管薪酬，尤其是股票期权，在塑造CEO面对不利事件时决策方面的强大作用。

papers.abstract_original: Although prior research has noted the stress-reducing effects of leaders’ initiating structure and consideration, these behaviors are often gendered, with initiating structure as agentic, masculine behavior and consideration as communal, feminine behavior. Given these gender-role expectations, we examine whether there are different implications of women and men leaders’ initiating structure and consideration in relation to employee stress and well-being. Integrating expectancy violation theory and stress appraisal theory, we argue that perceived leader behaviors that violate gender roles (i.e., initiating structure by women leaders and consideration by men leaders) will be more powerful in reducing employee threat appraisals, which then reduces self-regulation depletion and in turn enriches employee well-being. Two studies—a time-separated field study and a set of experiments—support our proposals. Implications for theory and practice are discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管先前研究已注意到领导者结构启动和关怀行为的减压效果，但这些行为往往带有性别色彩，结构启动被视为能动性的、男性化的行为，而关怀被视为共融性的、女性化的行为。鉴于这些性别角色期望，我们考察女性与男性领导者的结构启动和关怀行为在员工压力和幸福感方面是否存在不同影响。整合期望违背理论和压力评估理论，我们认为，感知到的违反性别角色的领导者行为（即女性领导者的结构启动和男性领导者的关怀）将更有力地减少员工的威胁评估，进而减少自我调节损耗，并最终提升员工幸福感。两项研究——一项时间分离的实地研究和一组实验——支持了我们的主张。本文讨论了理论和实践意义。

papers.abstract_original: Using signaling theory, this research examines the role that social support during pregnancy plays in reducing work–family guilt upon returning to work after maternity leave. Specifically, we consider four sources of social support (two from the work domain: supervisor and coworkers; and two from the non-work domain: spouse and friends) and the signaling effect they have on a mother’s work–family guilt upon returning to work after maternity leave and her subsequent job and family satisfaction. Based on a sample of 247 women who completed surveys both before taking maternity leave and upon returning to the workforce, we found that supervisor, coworker, and friend support enhanced job satisfaction through reduced work-induced guilt. Further, both supervisor and spouse support contributed to family satisfaction through reduced family-induced guilt. Spouse support reduced family-induced guilt significantly more than coworker support, offering some modest support for domain specificity. Further, when considering the interaction of within-domain effects, we found that the work domain sources of support interact to provide a stronger effect on job satisfaction, but the non-work domain sources do not interact significantly. This provides an enlightening look at social support’s different roles in working mom guilt during a pivotal time in a woman’s life, her return to work after childbirth.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究运用信号理论，考察孕期社会支持在减少产假后重返工作时的工作—家庭内疚感方面所发挥的作用。具体而言，我们考虑了四种社会支持来源（两种来自工作领域：主管和同事；两种来自非工作领域：配偶和朋友），以及它们对母亲产假后重返工作时的工作—家庭内疚感及其随后的工作和家庭满意度的信号效应。基于247名在休产假前和重返劳动力市场时均完成调查的女性样本，我们发现主管、同事和朋友的支持通过减少工作引发的内疚感提升了工作满意度。此外，主管和配偶的支持均通过减少家庭引发的内疚感促进了家庭满意度。配偶支持比同事支持更能显著减少家庭引发的内疚感，为领域特定性提供了一定的适度支持。此外，在考虑领域内效应的交互作用时，我们发现工作领域的支持来源相互作用，对工作满意度产生更强的效应，但非工作领域的支持来源没有显著的交互作用。这为理解社会支持在女性人生关键时期——产后重返工作——对职场妈妈内疚感的不同作用提供了启发性的视角。

papers.abstract_original: The perils of legitimacy threats for CBAs are widely acknowledged in the literature. However, prior research has focused on legitimacy threats stemming from factors not in the direct control of MNEs. In this study, we explore if and how acquirers’ CSI salience, a legitimacy threat stemming directly from the past actions and behaviors of the focal firm, influences a critical international expansion decision—the level of ownership obtained in cross-border acquisitions (CBAs). Drawing on neo-institutional theory, we argue that CSI salience reduces the level of ownership obtained in CBAs as it captures more stakeholder attention and is factored into their legitimacy evaluations. In addition, we examine how characteristics of the host country’s legitimating environment may attenuate or accentuate the legitimacy threat from CSI as they reflect how host country stakeholders notice, assess, and respond to CSI and the capacity of host institutions to monitor and enforce compliance. We find support for our hypotheses in a sample of 16,650 CBAs by 10,738 unique acquirers, and offer valuable insights into the interplay of CSI salience, legitimacy, and CBA ownership to research and practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 跨国并购（CBA）中合法性威胁的危险在文献中已被广泛认可。然而，先前研究主要关注源自跨国公司无法直接控制的因素所导致的合法性威胁。在本研究中，我们探讨收购方的企业社会不负责任（CSI）显著性——一种直接源自焦点企业过去行动和行为的合法性威胁——是否以及如何影响一项关键的国际扩张决策：跨国并购（CBA）中获得的所有权水平。基于新制度理论，我们认为CSI显著性降低了跨国并购中获得的所有权水平，因为它吸引了更多利益相关者的关注并被纳入其合法性评估。此外，我们考察东道国合法化环境的特征如何可能减弱或加剧来自CSI的合法性威胁，因为这些特征反映了东道国利益相关者如何注意、评估和回应CSI，以及东道国机构监督和执行合规的能力。我们在16,650起由10,738个独特收购方进行的跨国并购样本中找到了对假设的支持，并为研究与实践提供了关于CSI显著性、合法性与跨国并购所有权之间相互作用的有价值见解。

papers.abstract_original: Epiphanies—sudden realizations that transform how people see themselves—have the potential to infuse people’s personal and professional lives with a renewed sense of purpose. Yet, the prominence and potency of epiphanies as purpose-giving vehicles has largely been overlooked in management and organization studies. In the research reported here, we investigate epiphanies and their psychological foundations. Specifically, we build and test theory on what types of individuals, psychologically speaking, are more likely to experience epiphanies of greater strength related to their work and careers. We evaluate the strength of the work-related epiphanies that people experienced over the course of their lives (Study 1) and in the context of a leadership development program (Study 2) and a leadership coaching workshop (Study 3). Consistent with our theorizing, we find that people who engage in a form of mind wandering known as “problem-solving daydreaming” are more likely to experience work-related epiphanies of greater strength. Furthermore, we find that people who engage in problem-solving daydreaming are especially likely to experience work-related epiphanies of greater strength when they possess a form of curiosity that compels them to solve their problems (“deprivation sensitivity”). Work-related epiphany strength, in turn, transmits this conditional effect onto people’s sense of purpose in their careers via psychological tension resolution. These results illuminate psychological phenomena underlying sudden shifts in how people view themselves and open new windows into how a heightened sense of career purpose can emerge among individuals on a managerial career path.
papers.abstract_zh: 顿悟——即改变人们看待自身方式的突然领悟——有可能为人们的个人生活和职业生活注入一种焕然一新的目标感。然而，顿悟作为一种赋予目标的载体，其显著性和效力在管理与组织研究中很大程度上被忽视了。在本研究报告的研究中，我们考察顿悟及其心理基础。具体而言，我们构建并检验了关于从心理学角度而言哪些类型的个体更有可能经历与其工作和职业相关的更强顿悟的理论。我们评估了人们在各自人生历程中所经历的工作相关顿悟的强度（研究1），以及在领导力发展项目（研究2）和领导力教练工作坊（研究3）情境中的工作相关顿悟强度。与我们的理论相一致，我们发现，从事一种被称为“问题解决式白日梦”的心智游移形式的人，更有可能经历强度更大的工作相关顿悟。此外，我们发现，当从事问题解决式白日梦的人拥有一种驱使他们去解决自身问题的好奇心（“剥夺敏感性”）时，他们尤其有可能经历强度更大的工作相关顿悟。工作相关顿悟的强度反过来又通过心理张力的化解，将这一条件性效应传递到人们对其职业的目标感上。这些结果揭示了人们看待自身方式发生突然转变背后的心理现象，并为处于管理职业路径上的个体如何能够产生一种增强的职业目标感开辟了新的窗口。

papers.abstract_original: As robots become more integrated into the workplace, leaders are increasingly engaging in behaviors that anthropomorphize robots. Given that this form of leader behavior remains undertheorized, we conceptualize it as leader anthropomorphizing behavior toward robots (LABR)—an observable behavior through which leaders endow robots with human-like characteristics. Although practical wisdom and previous studies have highlighted a prevailing optimism about adopting LABR to manage human–robot teams, such optimism may be premature. Drawing on objectification theory, we develop a model that uncovers the detrimental effects of LABR on employees who observe such behavior. To test our model, we developed and validated a LABR scale (Study 1) and conducted five subsequent studies (Studies 2a–5) using vignette-based experiments and field surveys. The results showed that employees who observed LABR were more likely to perceive themselves as being objectified by their leaders, which in turn increased their likelihood of engaging in workplace deviance. By theorizing LABR and revealing its potential dark sides, we contribute to the literature on leader behavior, robot anthropomorphism, human–robot teams, and objectification.
papers.abstract_zh: 随着机器人日益融入工作场所，领导者越来越多地从事将机器人人格化的行为。鉴于这种形式的领导者行为仍缺乏充分的理论阐释，我们将其概念化为领导者对机器人的人格化行为（LABR）——一种可观察的行为，领导者通过该行为赋予机器人类似人类的特征。尽管实践智慧和以往研究都强调采用LABR来管理人机团队的主流乐观态度，但这种乐观可能为时过早。借鉴客体化理论，我们构建了一个模型，揭示LABR对观察到此类行为的员工的有害影响。为检验我们的模型，我们开发并验证了LABR量表（研究1），并随后开展了五项研究（研究2a–5），采用基于情境小品的实验和实地调查。结果表明，观察到LABR的员工更可能感知到自己被领导者客体化，这反过来增加了他们从事职场越轨行为的可能性。通过对LABR进行理论化并揭示其潜在的阴暗面，我们为领导者行为、机器人人格化、人机团队和客体化方面的文献做出了贡献。

papers.abstract_original: It is not uncommon for people to recount humbling experiences that have transformed how they see themselves and approach their work. Although the benefits of humbling experiences are widely assumed, we have an incomplete understanding of what these experiences entail and how they may help forge humility. Existing research consists largely of idiosyncratic lists of events that might be humbling without deeper inquiry into what makes these experiences unique or how they are integrated into one’s identity. Our theorizing combines insights from the sensemaking and humility literatures to specify the dynamic processes through which humbling experiences are internalized, including contingency factors that limit or enhance the impact of these events. This approach adds theoretical precision to the understanding of what it means to have had a humbling experience and challenges the implicit assumption that humility is a stable quality. In addition, we inform the debate about how humility relates to negative emotions and self-views by distinguishing humility itself from the process through which it is developed. Throughout the paper, we use leadership as an illustrative context to ground our theorizing, but the processes we propose apply across organizational roles. Altogether, this work provides a foundation for better understanding how humbling experiences cultivate humility—an attribute that allows individuals to approach their roles from a more self-aware, other-oriented perspective.
papers.abstract_zh: 人们常常讲述那些改变他们看待自身方式和对待工作方式的令人谦逊的经历，这并不罕见。尽管令人谦逊的经历所带来的益处被广泛假定，但我们对这些经历究竟包含什么以及它们如何有助于塑造谦逊的理解仍不完整。现有研究主要由可能令人谦逊的事件所构成的、各自不同的清单组成，而没有更深入地探究是什么使这些经历独特，或它们如何被整合进一个人的身份之中。我们的理论构建结合了意义建构文献与谦逊文献的洞见，以阐明令人谦逊的经历被内化的动态过程，包括限制或增强这些事件影响的权变因素。这种方法为理解“拥有一次令人谦逊的经历”意味着什么增添了理论精确性，并挑战了谦逊是一种稳定品质这一隐含假设。此外，我们通过将谦逊本身与谦逊得以发展的过程区分开来，为关于谦逊如何与负面情绪和自我看法相关联的争论提供了信息。在整篇论文中，我们以领导力作为说明性情境来为我们的理论构建奠定基础，但我们所提出的过程适用于各种组织角色。总而言之，这项工作为更好地理解令人谦逊的经历如何培育谦逊——一种使个体能够以更具自我意识、更以他人为导向的视角来对待其角色的属性——提供了基础。

papers.abstract_original: The organizational rituals literature has primarily focused on simple rituals and their positive effects on participants. While generative, this focus has obscured the intricacy and potential downsides of complex rituals, such as workplace celebrations and team-building retreats. In our research, we leverage Interaction Rituals Theory (IRT) to broaden the theoretical foundation of the study of organizational rituals by examining the range of experiences that employees have within complex organizational rituals. First, we inductively identify the positive and negative experiences within complex organizational rituals and create scales to measure them. Next, drawing further from IRT, we develop a model explaining how these experiences affect employee engagement and identify the subsequent work behaviors most likely to be affected by ritual-induced changes in engagement (helping, loyal boosterism, and job search behavior). In two field studies in the United States and Germany, we test this model, first in a single complex organizational ritual (i.e., company holiday party) and then across a broader set of common complex organizational rituals. Across both studies, we find that employees’ positive experiences during an organizational ritual enhance engagement and predict subsequent work behavior, while their effects can be significantly diminished by negative ritual experiences, challenging the assumption that rituals are uniformly beneficial. By providing evidence for a more balanced perspective on the impact of organizational rituals, our work provides a more nuanced and holistic understanding of the true nature of organizational rituals.
papers.abstract_zh: 组织仪式文献主要关注简单仪式及其对参与者的积极影响。尽管这种关注富有生成性，但它遮蔽了复杂仪式（如职场庆祝活动和团队建设退修会）的复杂性及潜在弊端。在我们的研究中，我们借助互动仪式理论（IRT）来拓宽组织仪式研究的理论基础，考察员工在复杂组织仪式中所经历的各种体验。首先，我们归纳性地识别出复杂组织仪式中的积极体验和消极体验，并创建量表来测量它们。接下来，进一步借鉴IRT，我们构建了一个模型，解释这些体验如何影响员工敬业度，并识别出最可能受仪式引发的敬业度变化影响的后续工作行为（助人行为、忠诚拥护行为和工作搜寻行为）。在美国和德国开展的两项实地研究中，我们检验了这一模型，首先是在单一复杂组织仪式（即公司假日聚会）中，然后在更广泛的一组常见复杂组织仪式中。在这两项研究中，我们发现员工在组织仪式期间的积极体验会增强敬业度并预测后续工作行为，而其效果可能被消极的仪式体验显著削弱，这挑战了仪式一律有益的假设。通过为组织仪式影响提供更平衡视角的证据，我们的工作对组织仪式的真实本质提供了更细致和整体的理解。

papers.abstract_original: Using property rights theory to examine the characteristics that enable family firms to exclude rivals from their competitive space, we explain why the family form of governance is often selected instead of the nonfamily form of governance and what determines the scale and scope of family firms. Family-centered nonpecuniary goals allow family firms to capture rights to common property opportunities that nonfamily firms find unattractive. Furthermore, the development and deployment of non-tradeable, immobile, inimitable, and indivisible human and nonhuman resources enable family firms to protect their property rights from competitors. Finally, because family members act as owners and managers, family firm governance can reduce the cost of monitoring as well as the possibility of opportunistic behavior and underinvestment of family resources.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文运用产权理论考察使家族企业能够将竞争对手排除在其竞争空间之外的特征，解释了为什么家族治理形式常常被选择而非非家族治理形式，以及是什么决定了家族企业的规模和范围。以家族为中心的非金钱目标使家族企业能够获取非家族企业认为缺乏吸引力的共有财产机会的权利。此外，不可交易、不可移动、不可模仿且不可分割的人力与非人力资源的开发和部署，使家族企业能够保护其产权免受竞争者侵害。最后，由于家族成员同时充当所有者和管理者，家族企业治理可以降低监督成本，以及机会主义行为和家族资源投资不足的可能性。

papers.abstract_original: A commonly held assumption is that firm-specific human capital benefits firms while constraining employees, particularly by reducing their external mobility. While this tension holds in many contexts, it overlooks the possibility that firm-specific human capital developed by one group of employees—managers—can generate positive externalities for others. Using a novel empirical setting and a 16-year panel of 19,044 establishments with 107,309 establishment-year observations, we find that an increase in managers’ firm-specific human capital is associated with improvements in workplace safety. These effects are especially pronounced in organizations with weak safety orientations and with higher proportions of lower-skill employees, who are typically more vulnerable to safety risks. Our findings reveal a previously underexplored channel through which firm-specific human capital creates value: by enabling managers to protect other employees. This challenges the prevailing view that firm-specific human capital primarily serves firm interests and highlights a broader set of beneficiaries—offering a new perspective on the role of managers’ firm-specific human capital in shaping organizational outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 一个普遍持有的假设是，企业专用性人力资本使企业受益，同时约束员工，尤其是通过降低其外部流动性。虽然这种张力在许多情境中成立，但它忽视了一种可能性，即由一类员工——管理者——所开发的企业专用性人力资本可以为他人产生正外部性。使用一个新的实证情境以及一个包含19,044家机构、107,309个机构-年份观测值的16年面板数据，我们发现管理者企业专用性人力资本的增加与工作场所安全性的改善相关。这些效应在安全导向较弱以及低技能员工比例较高的组织中尤为明显，而这类员工通常更容易受到安全风险的影响。我们的发现揭示了企业专用性人力资本创造价值的一个此前未被充分探索的渠道：通过使管理者能够保护其他员工。这挑战了关于企业专用性人力资本主要服务于企业利益的流行观点，并凸显了更广泛的受益者群体——为管理者企业专用性人力资本在塑造组织结果中的作用提供了新视角。

papers.abstract_original: Doing business in an autocracy that still permits the existence of markets is fundamentally different than operating under a democracy. This variety of state capitalism, termed authoritarian capitalism, requires specific form of political connections to the regime in order to survive and, in some cases, to thrive. However, authoritarian governance has another defining feature—namely paroxysms of political violence of different modalities, a phenomenon that can harm business but may benefit those who are connected to the regime. This paper examines life under a particular authoritarian capitalist state, 19th-century tsarist Russia, via an examination of one politically connected firm, the full-service steamship firm Kavkaz i Merkurii (Caucasus and Mercury). Using never-before-utilized company archival material to examine the firm’s relationship with the tsar, I find that management directly pursued intense business linkages with the government, even appointing tsarist officials and members of the royal family to leadership positions. This behavior increased even as political violence skyrocketed throughout Russia. A formal empirical analysis shows that this strategy was mostly beneficial for the firm, as some forms of political violence were received positively by shareholders as a source of new business. However, military action that drew heavily on the firm—where the government was underpaying relative to market rates—was perceived negatively by investors, and violence, which could have threatened the regime, manifested in higher long-term volatility. This paper shows both the benefits and costs associated with political connections under authoritarian capitalism.
papers.abstract_zh: 在一个仍允许市场存在的专制政体中经商，与在民主制度下经营有着根本的不同。这种国家资本主义的变体被称为威权资本主义，它要求与政权建立特定形式的政治联系才能生存，在某些情况下才能繁荣。然而，威权治理还有另一个决定性特征——即不同形式的政治暴力爆发，这一现象可能损害企业，但可能有利于那些与政权有联系的人。本文通过考察一家有政治联系的企业——提供全方位服务的轮船公司Kavkaz i Merkurii（高加索与墨丘利）——来研究特定威权资本主义国家19世纪沙皇俄国时期的生活。利用此前从未被使用的公司档案材料来考察该公司与沙皇的关系，我发现管理层直接寻求与政府建立紧密的商业联系，甚至任命沙皇官员和王室成员担任领导职位。即使在整个俄罗斯政治暴力飙升之际，这种行为也有增无减。一项正式的实证分析表明，这一策略对公司大多有利，因为某些形式的政治暴力被股东视为新业务的来源而受到积极评价。然而，大量征用该公司的军事行动——政府支付的报酬低于市场价格——被投资者视为负面，而可能威胁政权的暴力则表现为更高的长期波动性。本文展示了威权资本主义下政治联系所带来的收益与成本。

papers.abstract_original: A documented recent rise in the polarization of American legislative politics underscores the question of how increasing political polarization affects organizations and industries. Yet, organizational scholars have not directed significant attention to the impact of polarization. In this paper, we demonstrate that political polarization may play an important role in organizational dynamics by revealing that polarization may expedite the destigmatization of legal yet historically stigmatized industries. To this end, we develop a theory explaining how political polarization normalizes counter-normative behavior and encourages customers to become open about their engagement with stigmatized products and organizations—a key step toward industry destigmatization. We further argue that this polarization impact may vary across regional markets because of differences in local legitimation processes that can either amplify (normative legitimacy) or attenuate (regulatory legitimacy) the effect of polarization on consumer engagement with a stigmatized industry. We find empirical evidence for our theorizing in analyses of all U.S. dispensaries of medical marijuana that existed on the online platform Weedmaps.com from its beginning in 2008 to 2014. Ultimately, this paper suggests that political polarization can significantly influence organizations and industries and thus warrants more systematic investigation and attention from organizational scholars, particularly in stigmatized industries.
papers.abstract_zh: 近期有文献记载美国立法政治极化的加剧，这凸显了一个问题：日益加剧的政治极化如何影响组织和行业。然而，组织学者尚未对极化的影响给予显著关注。在本文中，我们通过揭示极化可能加速那些合法但历史上被污名化的行业的去污名化，证明政治极化可能在组织动态中发挥重要作用。为此，我们构建了一个理论，解释政治极化如何使反规范行为正常化，并鼓励顾客公开其与受污名化产品和组织的接触——这是行业去污名化的关键一步。我们进一步认为，这种极化影响可能因地区市场而异，原因在于地方合法化过程的差异，这些过程可能放大（规范性合法性）或减弱（规制性合法性）极化对消费者接触受污名化行业的影响。我们在对从2008年Weedmaps.com平台创立之初至2014年间该平台上存在的所有美国医用大麻药房的分析中，为我们的理论找到了实证证据。最终，本文表明政治极化能够显著影响组织和行业，因此值得组织学者进行更系统的研究和关注，尤其是在受污名化的行业中。

papers.abstract_original: Complementing research on the implications of political ties for firms’ strategic decisions and financial performance, recent studies are increasingly focusing on the environmental consequences of firms’ political connections. We contribute to this stream of work by integrating insights from the literature on political ties and the multifaceted nature of governments to explore how the level of government influences the pollution implications of firms’ political ties. Specifically, we theorize and demonstrate that, in China, firms’ achieved political ties with high levels of the government reduce pollution, while such ties with low levels of the government increase it. Furthermore, we examine how these relationships are moderated by firm owners’ social class and the attention by different levels of the government to their respective primary goals. Our analysis of data from 6,758 privately-owned Chinese enterprises provides support for our predictions. Our main conceptual contribution is to add more nuance to the research on political ties by highlighting the contingent role of the level of government in shaping firms’ pollution outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 作为对政治关系对企业战略决策和财务绩效影响研究的补充，近期研究日益关注企业政治关联的环境后果。我们通过整合政治关系文献的洞见以及政府多面性本质，探讨政府层级如何影响企业政治关系的污染后果，从而为这一研究流做出贡献。具体而言，我们提出理论并证明，在中国，企业与高层级政府建立的政治关系会减少污染，而此类与低层级政府的关系则会增加污染。此外，我们考察了企业所有者的社会阶层以及不同层级政府对其各自首要目标的关注如何调节这些关系。我们对6,758家中国私营企业数据的分析支持了我们的预测。我们的主要概念性贡献在于，通过强调政府层级在塑造企业污染结果中的权变作用，为政治关系研究增添了更多细微之处。
papers.title_original: Not All Political Ties Are the Same: Firms’ Ties to the Government and Pollution
papers.title_zh: 并非所有政治关系都相同：企业与政府的关系及污染

papers.abstract_original: This article explores the important but understudied topic of authenticity in investment evaluations. Building on research in authenticity and signaling theory, we theorize how visual first impressions, such as clothing, can generate perceptions of authenticity that lead investors to overlook later quality signals, including a lack of prior experience. We found support for our theory in two field studies and a randomized experiment: investors tend to perceive entrepreneurs who are casually dressed as more authentic than those formally dressed, which is associated with higher investor evaluations. Moreover, perceptions of authenticity generated by casual clothes crowd out later signals: Casually dressed entrepreneurs are evaluated highly regardless of their entrepreneurial experience, but formally dressed entrepreneurs are penalized for perceived inexperience. We discuss the implications of our findings for authenticity research, the temporal order of signals, and early-stage investments.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了投资评估中真实性的这一重要但研究不足的主题。基于真实性研究和信号理论，我们构建理论，说明诸如服装之类的视觉第一印象如何能够产生真实性感知，进而导致投资者忽视后续的质量信号，包括缺乏先前经验。我们在两项实地研究和一项随机实验中找到了对我们理论的支持：投资者倾向于认为穿着随意的创业者比穿着正式的创业者更真实，而这与更高的投资者评估相关联。此外，由随意服装产生的真实性感知会挤出后续信号：穿着随意的创业者无论其创业经验如何都会得到高评价，而穿着正式的创业者则会因被感知为缺乏经验而受到惩罚。我们讨论了我们的发现对真实性研究、信号的时间顺序以及早期投资的意义。

papers.abstract_original: The evolution of innovation ecosystems hinges on the effective coordination between ecosystem leaders and complementors. While ecosystem-sponsored architectural innovations create new technological opportunities for complementors, they may unintentionally disrupt the performance of complementor products that were originally developed based on legacy architectural designs. This study provides empirical evidence of these disruptive effects and explores how complementors’ alignment with the ecosystem leader mitigates such challenges. Focusing on Apple’s release of Core ML—a proprietary artificial intelligence module—in its mobile ecosystem, we employ a difference-in-differences design to investigate variations in complementor performance after adopting this ecosystem-sponsored architectural innovation. Our findings reveal that complementors’ technological and flow alignment with the ecosystem leader is critical for minimizing performance disruptions and enhancing value creation during ecosystem evolution. This study enriches our understanding of architectural changes and complementor heterogeneity in innovation ecosystems.
papers.abstract_zh: 创新生态系统的演化取决于生态系统领导者与互补者之间的有效协调。虽然生态系统主导的架构创新为互补者创造了新的技术机会，但它们可能无意中破坏原本基于旧有架构设计开发的互补者产品的绩效。本研究为这些破坏性效应提供了实证证据，并探讨互补者与生态系统领导者的对齐如何缓解此类挑战。我们聚焦于苹果在其移动生态系统中发布Core ML——一个专有的人工智能模块——采用双重差分设计，考察互补者在采用这一生态系统主导的架构创新之后绩效的变化。我们的发现表明，互补者在技术与流程上与生态系统领导者的对齐，对于在生态系统演化过程中最大限度地减少绩效中断和增强价值创造至关重要。本研究丰富了我们对创新生态系统中架构变革和互补者异质性的理解。
papers.title_original: Marching to the Beat: The Role of Complementor Alignment in the Architectural Evolution of Ecosystems
papers.title_zh: 随节拍前行：互补者在生态系统架构演化中的对齐作用

papers.abstract_original: Despite the recognition that newcomers’ ego networks facilitate their adjustment, little is known about changes in their ego-network structures over time and potential drivers for the network changes. Drawing on coevolutionary theory of network dynamics and integrating insights from research on socialization dynamics, we examine the change-related, reciprocal relationships between perceived supervisor behaviors—specifically support and undermining—and structural holes in newcomers’ ego networks (i.e., the extent to which newcomers connect otherwise disconnected individuals). Using latent change score (LCS) modeling in a longitudinal study of new employees, we found evidence of coevolution: perceived supervisor undermining hindered their development of ego networks with increasingly more structural holes; in turn, newcomers who spanned structural holes in their ego networks experienced increasingly more supervisor undermining. Additionally, those whose networks are rich in structural holes perceived increasingly less supervisor support over time. These findings have implications for research on socialization and structural holes.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管人们已认识到新员工的自我网络有助于其适应，但对其自我网络结构随时间的变化以及网络变化的潜在驱动因素却知之甚少。我们借鉴网络动态的共同演化理论，并整合社会化动态研究的洞见，考察感知到的主管行为——具体而言是支持和破坏行为——与新员工自我网络中的结构洞（即新员工将原本互不相连的个体连接起来的程度）之间与变化相关的互惠关系。我们在一项针对新员工的纵向研究中使用潜在变化分数（LCS）建模，发现了共同演化的证据：感知到的主管破坏行为阻碍了他们发展出结构洞日益增多的自我网络；反过来，在自我网络中跨越结构洞的新员工则经历到日益增多的主管破坏行为。此外，那些网络富含结构洞的人随着时间推移感知到的主管支持越来越少。这些发现对社会化和结构洞研究具有启示意义。

papers.abstract_original: While those transitioning into a new work role often rely on others to assist them, over time they are likely to also provide assistance to others. Accordingly, we examine the trajectories that the provision of such help by those transitioning take over time, as well as key trajectory determinants and socialization-related outcomes. Extending the Temporal Theory of Organizational Citizenship Behavior (TTOCB), we argue and find that such trajectories vary as a function of both the nature of the transition (i.e., transitioning as an organizational incumbent versus as an organizational newcomer), as well as the leadership and normative characteristics of the unit joined. Specifically, we propose and find that both newcomers and transitioning incumbents exhibit an inverted U-shaped helping trajectory, with the trajectory being significantly flatter for transitioning incumbents. Moreover, unit-level supportive leadership and peer descriptive helping norms moderate these trajectories. For both newcomers and transitioning incumbents, the helping trajectory is flatter in units with higher levels of supportive leadership or peer descriptive helping norms. Consistent with these dynamics, we hypothesize and find that variations in helping trajectories are associated with different levels of task performance, social integration, and turnover intentions one year after role entry. Specifically, individuals exhibiting higher and flatter helping trajectories demonstrate higher task performance, greater social integration, and lower turnover intentions. Theoretical and practical implications are discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然那些转换到新工作角色的人常常依赖他人来帮助自己，但随着时间推移，他们很可能也会向他人提供帮助。因此，我们考察了那些正在转换角色的人所提供的此类帮助随时间推移而形成的轨迹，以及关键的轨迹决定因素和与 socialization 相关的结果。扩展组织公民行为的时间理论（TTOCB），我们论证并发现，此类轨迹会因转换的性质（即作为组织在职者转换还是作为组织新进者转换）以及所加入单元的领导与规范特征而变化。具体而言，我们提出并发现，新进者和转换中的在职者都表现出倒U型的帮助轨迹，而在职者转换者的轨迹显著更平缓。此外，单元层面的支持性领导和同伴描述性帮助规范会调节这些轨迹。对于新进者和转换中的在职者而言，在支持性领导水平或同伴描述性帮助规范水平更高的单元中，帮助轨迹更平缓。与这些动态一致，我们假设并发现，帮助轨迹的变化与角色进入一年后不同水平的工作绩效、社会整合和离职意向相关。具体而言，表现出更高且更平缓帮助轨迹的个体展现出更高的工作绩效、更强的社会整合和更低的离职意向。本文讨论了理论与实践意义。
papers.title_original: Helping Trajectories During Role Transitions: How They Vary and Why It Matters
papers.title_zh: 角色转换期间的帮助轨迹：它们如何变化以及为何重要

papers.abstract_original: This study examines shareholder activism and its consequences for corporate directors’ career trajectories. We begin by highlighting that the inherent ambiguity surrounding activist interventions implies variation in director careers beyond an overall negative effect. Specifically, we posit and test the notion that the director labor market will differentiate between financially based versus socially based shareholder unrest, with the latter having a stronger negative effect based on (1) its greater information value above and beyond what is already knowable about the firm, and (2) heightened recognition of the need for directors to balance financial performance pressures with responsiveness to evolving environmental, social, and governance concerns. Empirically, we analyze U.S. shareholder activism events between 2014 and 2018, and using Coarsened Exact Matching combined with a Difference-in-Differences approach, we find evidence consistent with our disambiguation perspective on shareholder activism. Our theoretical and empirical analyses also further disambiguate whether director exits reflect market or/and director preferences, and we find evidence for both. We conclude by discussing how our theoretical perspective and empirical findings contribute to research on shareholder activism, director labor markets, and corporate governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察股东积极主义及其对公司董事职业轨迹的后果。我们首先强调，围绕积极主义干预的固有模糊性意味着董事职业生涯的变化不止于整体负面效应。具体而言，我们提出并检验了这样一种观点：董事劳动力市场将区分基于财务的股东不满与基于社会的股东不满，后者具有更强的负面效应，其依据是（1）其超越已可获知的关于公司的信息之外具有更大的信息价值，以及（2）人们更加认识到董事需要在财务绩效压力与对不断演变的环境、社会和治理关切的回应性之间取得平衡。在实证上，我们分析了2014年至2018年间的美国股东积极主义事件，并使用粗化精确匹配结合双重差分方法，发现了与我们对股东积极主义的厘清视角相一致的证据。我们的理论和实证分析还进一步厘清了董事退出反映的是市场偏好还是/以及董事偏好，我们发现了二者兼有的证据。最后，我们讨论了我们的理论视角和实证发现如何为股东积极主义、董事劳动力市场和公司治理研究做出贡献。

papers.abstract_original: Micromanagement (MM) is a popular topic in management circles, where its negative reputation is palpable, and yet academics have not shared this interest. As a result, our understanding of MM is deficient, marred by disjointed definitions and paradoxical views. Our research aims to clarify the construct and measurement of MM through a series of five studies that (1) define the MM construct, (2) develop a psychometrically reliable and valid measure, and (3) validate a preliminary nomological network. Based on combined deductive and inductive approaches, we establish a comprehensive construct definition of MM. Subsequently, we develop and validate a nine-item Micromanagement Scale (MMS-9). Drawing on data from eight distinct samples encompassing 1,723 individuals employed across diverse industries, we found that (a) MM is a hierarchical construct comprising three related core attributes (i.e., controlling, close monitoring, detail focus) and three key features (i.e., excessive, sustained, unnecessary), (b) the MMS-9 exhibits nomological validity, as evidenced by its significant relationships with theorized antecedents (e.g., low trust and leader-member exchange) and consequences (e.g., high turnover intentions and emotional exhaustion), and (c) the MMS-9 demonstrates discriminant and incremental validity against relevant orbiting leadership constructs (i.e., authoritarian leadership, participative leadership, empowering leadership, initiating structure, directive leadership, and abusive supervision). We discuss the implications of the MMS-9’s availability for advancing the study of micromanagement, with particular focus on potential avenues for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 微观管理（MM）是管理圈中的热门话题，其负面名声显而易见，然而学术界却并未分享这种兴趣。因此，我们对MM的理解存在不足，受到彼此脱节的定义和自相矛盾观点的损害。我们的研究旨在通过一系列五项研究来澄清MM的构念与测量，这些研究（1）界定MM构念，（2）开发一个心理测量学上可靠且有效的测量工具，并（3）验证一个初步的法理网络。基于演绎与归纳相结合的方法，我们建立了MM的全面构念定义。随后，我们开发并验证了一个包含九个题项的微观管理量表（MMS-9）。基于来自八个不同样本、涵盖1,723名受雇于不同行业个体的数据，我们发现：（a）MM是一个层级构念，包含三个相关的核心属性（即控制、密切监控、关注细节）和三个关键特征（即过度、持续、不必要）；（b）MMS-9表现出法理效度，其证据是与理论化的前因（例如低信任和领导-成员交换）和后果（例如高离职意向和情绪耗竭）之间存在显著关系；（c）MMS-9相对于相关的环绕型领导构念（即威权领导、参与式领导、授权领导、结构启动、指令型领导和辱虐管理）表现出区分效度和增量效度。我们讨论了MMS-9的可用性对推进微观管理研究的启示，特别关注未来研究的潜在方向。

papers.abstract_original: Narcissistic CEOs have been found to invest in corporate social responsibility (CSR) in prior research, but the empirical results are not straightforward. To address this, we bring in the institutional context as a moderator. We build on neo-institutional theory to argue that the institutional context shapes what audiences value and find legitimate in terms of CSR behaviors: Corporate philanthropy, a form of tactical CSR, is appreciated in liberal market economies (LMEs) but less so in coordinated market economies (CMEs), whereas strategic CSR, which requires a long-term horizon and substantial resource investments, is considered legitimate in CMEs but less so in LMEs. We theorize that narcissistic CEOs will try to pursue excellence (among their peers) in CSR activities that align with the norms and expectations in their institutional context in order to gain praise and avoid disapproval from their audiences and to bolster their moral superiority. Hence, we expect that the institutional context will moderate the relationship between CEO narcissism and CSR behavior such that in LMEs narcissistic CEOs will engage more in philanthropy than their peers but not in strategic CSR, whereas in CMEs they will invest more in strategic CSR but not in philanthropy. We test our predictions using panel data (2002-2023) from 148 large firms and 493 CEOs operating in 18 countries. Our pattern of findings supports our theory. By developing and testing a theoretical mechanism that connects macro-level institutional context with micro-level firm and CEO behavior, we contribute to both strategic leadership and CSR literature.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前研究发现，自恋型CEO会投资于企业社会责任（CSR），但实证结果并不明确。为应对这一问题，我们引入制度情境作为调节变量。我们基于新制度理论提出，制度情境塑造了受众在CSR行为方面所看重并认为合法的内容：企业慈善作为一种战术性CSR形式，在自由市场经济体（LMEs）中受到赞赏，但在协调市场经济体（CMEs）中则较少如此；而战略性CSR需要长期视野和大量资源投入，在CMEs中被视为合法，但在LMEs中则较少如此。我们构建理论认为，自恋型CEO会试图在与某制度情境中的规范和期望相一致的CSR活动中（在其同行中）追求卓越，以获得受众的赞扬并避免其反对，同时强化其道德优越感。因此，我们预期制度情境会调节CEO自恋与CSR行为之间的关系，使得在LMEs中，自恋型CEO会比其同行更多地参与慈善，但不会更多参与战略性CSR；而在CMEs中，他们会更多投资于战略性CSR，但不会更多参与慈善。我们使用来自18个国家中148家大型企业和493位CEO的面板数据（2002-2023）检验了我们的预测。我们的发现模式支持了我们的理论。通过开发并检验一种将宏观层面制度情境与微观层面企业和CEO行为相连接的理论机制，我们对战略领导力和CSR文献均作出了贡献。

papers.abstract_original: Prior research suggests that firm-specific human capital is important in enabling board chairs to effectively lead their boards in their oversight duties. Despite this, some boards appoint newcomer directors to the chair position. This paper seeks to explain why. Building on power circulation and faultline theories, we posit that boards characterized by strongly divided subgroups with none dominant over the board may have difficulty in agreeing on promoting a director from among their ranks to the chair position, and instead select a board newcomer as a compromise solution. We further argue that this will be moderated by factors that affect either the power dynamics or the degree of contestation on the board. Analyses on a sample of 2,199 board chair appointments at S&P 1500 firms between the years 2001 and 2017 support our hypotheses.
papers.abstract_zh: 先前研究提示，企业专用性人力资本对于使董事会主席能够有效领导董事会履行其监督职责十分重要。尽管如此，一些董事会仍任命外部新任董事担任主席职位。本文试图解释其原因。基于权力循环理论和断层线理论，我们提出，当董事会以严重分裂的子群体为特征且没有任何一个子群体在董事会中占据主导地位时，董事会可能难以就从其成员中提拔一名董事担任主席达成一致，转而选择一名董事会外部新任者作为妥协方案。我们进一步认为，这将会受到那些影响董事会权力动态或争夺程度的因素的调节。对2001年至2017年间标普1500家公司中2,199次董事会主席任命的样本分析支持了我们的假设。

papers.abstract_original: Inventor rewards—monetary compensation for employees who generate patents—are widely used to promote innovation. Yet the same incentives can steer innovation toward productivity (quantity) or toward inventiveness (quality). Based on social identity theorizing, we argue that inventors’ social identity order—lower versus higher—explains this heterogeneity. Lower-order identities, exemplified by technological specialists, are tightly constructed around exclusive, proximal membership with actively policed expectations—such as strict inventiveness norms—whereas higher-order identities, exemplified by generalists, are more distal and loosely policed, providing limited social constraints on behavior. Rewards activate identity, and the desire for incentive-identity alignment then guides behavior, with stronger pressures to conform to ingroup standards under lower-order than higher-order identities. Hence, we predict that, in response to inventor rewards, specialists produce fewer but more-inventive patents whereas generalists increase productivity at the expense of inventiveness, defaulting to prototypical reward-maximizing behavior. Further, in mixed-identity teams, specialists’ norms are projected onto generalists, raising their inventiveness in response to inventor rewards. We test these predictions using a difference-in-differences estimation and matched inventor-patent data from before and after a regulatory change in China mandating inventor rewards in state-owned enterprises. Consistent with our theory, after the mandate, generalists filed more but less-inventive patents, specialists produced fewer but more-inventive patents, and generalists in mixed teams became more inventive. By linking social identity order to reward responses, we clarify how to align incentives and the R&D workforce with desired innovation outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 发明人奖励——对产生专利的员工给予金钱补偿——被广泛用于促进创新。然而，同样的激励既可能将创新引向生产率（数量），也可能引向创造性（质量）。基于社会认同理论，我们认为发明人的社会认同序位——较低与较高——解释了这种异质性。较低序位的认同，以技术专家为典型，紧密围绕排他性的、近端的成员身份构建，并伴有被积极维护的期望——如严格的创造性规范——而较高序位的认同，以通才为典型，则更为远端且维护松散，对行为提供有限的社会约束。奖励激活认同，而对激励—认同一致性的渴望随后引导行为，在较低序位认同下比在较高序位认同下存在更强的压力去遵从内群体标准。因此，我们预测，在回应发明人奖励时，专家会产生更少但更具创造性的专利，而通才则以牺牲创造性为代价提高生产率，默认采取典型的奖励最大化行为。此外，在混合认同团队中，专家的规范会被投射到通才身上，提高他们在回应发明人奖励时的创造性。我们使用双重差分估计以及中国一项要求国有企业在规定中实施发明人奖励的监管变化前后的匹配发明人—专利数据来检验这些预测。与我们的理论一致，在该规定实施后，通才提交了更多但创造性更低的专利，专家产生了更少但更具创造性的专利，而混合团队中的通才变得更具创造性。通过将社会认同序位与奖励反应联系起来，我们阐明了如何使激励和研发人员队伍与期望的创新结果相一致。

papers.abstract_original: Although some scholars in strategic human resource management (SHRM) research have suggested that HRM investments can be effective in reducing the negative repercussions of employee downsizing, other scholars have argued that such HRM investments could convey contradictory messages to employees, resulting in more negative employee reactions and decreased firm performance. In this research, we addressed this unsettled question by looking into the mergers and acquisitions (M&A) context, where we theorized that the acquiring firm’s HRM investments can positively moderate the negative effect of employee downsizing on firm performance by invoking positive sensemaking processes from remaining acquired firm employees. Moreover, the positive sensemaking effects of HRM investments extend beyond remaining acquired firm employees to influence the overall performance of the merged firm. We examined established HRM investments by acquiring firms prior to the M&A and additional HRM investments made after the M&A. Using a representative sample of 5,467 firm-year observations from 1,214 U.S. publicly traded firms between 2002 and 2018, we found that both pre- and post-acquisition HRM investments by acquiring firms mitigate the negative effect of employee downsizing following M&A on firm performance. We discuss the implications of these findings for both research and practice.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管战略人力资源管理（SHRM）研究中的一些学者提出，人力资源管理投资可以有效减少员工裁员的负面后果，但其他学者则认为，此类人力资源管理投资可能向员工传递相互矛盾的信息，从而导致更负面的员工反应并降低企业绩效。在本研究中，我们通过考察并购（M&A）情境来回应这一尚未解决的问题，在该情境中，我们从理论上提出，收购方的人力资源管理投资可以通过激发被收购企业留任员工的积极意义建构过程，正向调节员工裁员对企业绩效的负向影响。此外，人力资源管理投资的积极意义建构效应不仅延伸到被收购企业的留任员工，还会影响合并后企业的整体绩效。我们考察了收购方在并购前已建立的人力资源管理投资以及并购后追加的人力资源管理投资。使用来自1,214家美国上市公司在2002年至2018年间5,467个企业-年度观测值的代表性样本，我们发现，收购方在收购前和收购后的人力资源管理投资都缓解了并购后员工裁员对企业绩效的负向影响。我们讨论了这些发现对研究和实践的启示。

papers.abstract_original: The literature on organizational paradoxes emphasizes the importance of both/and thinking and action. Yet, while often treated as a unitary concept, both/and has been interpreted and operationalized in diverse ways—such as ambidexterity, transcendence, Yin-Yang balancing, and Zhong-Yong middle way. To enhance conceptual clarity and coherence, this paper decomposes the notion of both/and and identifies generic strategies for simultaneously engaging paradoxical opposites. I begin by reviewing individual responses and prior classifications of responses to paradoxical tensions, which reveals five distinct responses beyond either/or logics. Building on these, I develop a typology that specifies and relates five variants of both/and thinking. These are organized into five ideal types—superficial Either-And, multiversal Both-Or, ambivalent Both-And, reconciliatory Both-Nor, and transcendent Neither-And—collectively forming the acronym SMART. I illustrate the application of the SMART framework by analyzing how organizations navigate the profitability versus responsibility tension, a paradox central to modern business practice. I conclude the paper by identifying the limitations of the present study and avenues for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 关于组织悖论的文献强调“兼而有之”思维与行动的重要性。然而，尽管“兼而有之”常被视为一个单一概念，它却以多种方式被解释和操作化——例如双元性、超越、阴阳平衡以及中庸之道。为增强概念清晰度和一致性，本文分解了“兼而有之”这一概念，并识别出同时应对悖论性对立面的一般性策略。我首先回顾了个体反应以及先前对悖论性张力反应的分类，这揭示了超越“非此即彼”逻辑的五种不同反应。在此基础上，我构建了一个类型学，明确并关联了“兼而有之”思维的五种变体。这些变体被组织为五种理想类型——肤浅的“既此亦彼”、多元宇宙式的“兼而有之或”、矛盾的“兼而有之”、调和式的“既不此也不彼”，以及超越式的“既不此亦彼”——共同构成首字母缩略词SMART。我通过分析组织如何应对盈利与责任之间的张力——这一现代商业实践核心的悖论——来说明SMART框架的应用。我在论文结尾指出了本研究的局限以及未来研究的途径。

papers.abstract_original: Feeling appreciated is integral to developing and sustaining high-quality relationships, yet many employees do not feel appreciated at work. Drawing on risk regulation theory for interdependent relationships, we developed a risk regulation model of supervisor gratitude expression, felt appreciation, and subordinate voice. We propose that when a supervisor’s agentic or communal gratitude expression aligns with a subordinate’s preference, the subordinate will experience greater felt appreciation and thus engage more in voice—a relationally risky behavior. First, we followed a five-step scale-development process using four distinct samples to create and validate measures of supervisors’ agentic and communal gratitude expression and subordinates’ corresponding preferences. We then tested our model in a multiwave, multisource field survey with 124 supervisor–subordinate dyads. We found that the congruence (incongruence) between supervisor gratitude expression and subordinate preference was positively (negatively) related to subordinate felt appreciation and subsequent voice, with distinct patterns emerging for supervisor agentic and communal expression. Further, in two supplementary experiments, we demonstrated that felt appreciation promotes voice via perceived regard and perceived reduction of relational risk. We discuss the theoretical and practical implications, highlighting the importance of distinguishing the two types of supervisor gratitude expressions and their responsiveness to subordinate preferences while outlining promising avenues for research on gratitude and felt appreciation at work.
papers.abstract_zh: 感受到被感激对于发展和维持高质量关系至关重要，然而许多员工在工作中并未感受到被感激。借鉴关于相互依赖关系的冒险调节理论，我们构建了一个关于主管感恩表达、感受到的感激与下属建言的冒险调节模型。我们提出，当主管的能动型或 communal 感恩表达与下属的偏好相一致时，下属会体验到更强的感受到的感激，从而更多地参与建言——一种在关系上具有风险的行为。首先，我们采用五步量表开发流程，使用四个不同样本创建并验证了主管能动型和 communal 感恩表达以及下属相应偏好的测量工具。随后，我们在一个包含124个主管-下属二元关系的多波次、多来源实地调查中检验了我们的模型。我们发现，主管感恩表达与下属偏好之间的一致（不一致）与下属感受到的感激及随后的建言呈正（负）相关，并且主管能动型表达和 communal 表达呈现出不同模式。此外，在两项补充实验中，我们证明感受到的感激会通过感知到的重视和感知到的关系风险降低来促进建言。我们讨论了理论与实践意义，强调区分两类主管感恩表达及其对下属偏好的响应性的重要性，同时概述了关于工作中感恩与感受到的感激的有前景的研究方向。

papers.abstract_original: Employees identify with multiple groups at work, each with distinct values and behavioral expectations. Though the identification literature argues that the relative effects of different identification groups vary depending on their subjective importance and situational relevance, identification is still largely conceptualized as stable, independent, and static. This ignores how different identifications might fluctuate in salience throughout the day and how they might influence each other. We extend the identification literature through the development of a theoretical model of dynamic identification—demonstrating that workplace conflict is a primary mechanism through which identification fluctuates, as well as the simultaneous effects of different identifications (i.e., team and organization) on important workplace outcomes. In a multistudy approach including two ESM studies and supplemental experiments, we demonstrate that increased conflict in a focal group reduced focal group identification salience and that this effect was strengthened when nonfocal group conflict was low, such that the nonfocal identification represented a “greener pasture” compared to the focal group.
papers.abstract_zh: 员工在工作中认同多个群体，每个群体都有不同的价值观和行为期望。尽管认同文献认为，不同认同群体的相对效应会因其主观重要性和情境相关性而变化，但认同在很大程度上仍被概念化为稳定的、独立的和静态的。这忽视了不同认同在一天中其显著性可能如何波动，以及它们可能如何相互影响。我们通过构建一个动态认同的理论模型来扩展认同文献——表明工作场所冲突是认同发生波动的主要机制，以及不同认同（即团队和组织）对重要工作结果的同步影响。在一项包括两项ESM研究和补充实验的多研究设计中，我们表明，焦点群体中冲突增加会降低焦点群体认同显著性，并且当非焦点群体冲突较低时，这一效应会增强，从而使得非焦点认同相对于焦点群体成为一种“更绿的牧场”。

papers.abstract_original: Cronyism promotes the exchange of favors among connected parties based on relationships rather than merit, granting them undue advantages in securing opportunities and resources. This study examines the impact of cronyism on the quantity and quality of entrepreneurship. The analysis of data from 98 countries over 8 years (482 country-year observations) indicates that cronyism is negatively associated with the quantity of productive entrepreneurship, and positively associated with the prevalence of unproductive entrepreneurship. Furthermore, the results reveal that cronyism diminishes the quality of entrepreneurship productivity across countries. Interestingly, the findings suggest that a stronger rule of law exacerbates the detrimental effects of cronyism on entrepreneurship productivity. These results extend our understanding of cronyism as a crucial yet understudied informal institution with major implications for management and entrepreneurship.
papers.abstract_zh: 任人唯亲基于关系而非才能促进有关系各方之间的利益交换，使他们在获取机会和资源方面获得不当优势。本研究考察任人唯亲对创业数量和质量的影响。对98个国家在8年间的数据（482个国家-年份观测值）进行的分析表明，任人唯亲与生产性创业的数量呈负相关，与非生产性创业的普遍程度呈正相关。此外，结果表明，任人唯亲降低了各国创业生产率的质量。有趣的是，研究结果表明，更强的法治会加剧任人唯亲对创业生产率的不利影响。这些结果拓展了我们将任人唯亲理解为一种关键但研究不足的非正式制度的认识，对管理学与创业学具有重大意义。

papers.abstract_original: Foreigners are often subject to stereotyping and discrimination, challenges typically associated with negative outcomes in the literature. In contrast, this study explores the potential benefits of such experiences for expatriates. Using an abductive approach, informed by self-categorization theory and impression management theory, we draw on interviews with 102 German expatriates in China, Korea, and Japan to examine 1) the stereotyping and resulting preferential discrimination expatriates experience abroad and 2) how expatriates strategically utilize stereotypes to their advantage. Our findings reveal that both positive and negative stereotypes can lead to preferential discrimination. Expatriates may benefit from immediate trust, privileged access to decision-makers, and what is often referred to as a “foreigner bonus.” Rather than passively accepting stereotyping, expatriates actively leveraged it through three strategies—trustworthy actor, powerful messenger, cultural clueless foreigner—to gain individual and organizational benefits. These strategic performances were often encouraged by local colleagues and superiors. By uncovering how expatriates engage in stereotypical behavior to enhance outcomes, this study reframes foreignness as a valuable asset that can be performed situationally and relationally. This perspective offers valuable managerial implications and advances theoretical understanding of cross-cultural interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 外国人常常成为刻板印象和歧视的对象，这些挑战在文献中通常与负面结果相关联。与此相反，本研究探讨了此类经历对外派人员的潜在益处。我们采用溯因方法，以自我归类理论和印象管理理论为指导，基于对102名在中国、韩国和日本工作的德国外派人员的访谈，考察了1）外派人员在国外经历的刻板印象及由此产生的优待性歧视，以及2）外派人员如何战略性地利用刻板印象为己谋利。我们的研究发现，正面和负面的刻板印象都可能导致优待性歧视。外派人员可能受益于即时信任、接触决策者的特权渠道，以及通常所说的“外国人红利”。外派人员并非被动接受刻板印象，而是通过三种策略——可信赖的行动者、有影响力的信息传递者、文化上懵懂的外国人——主动利用刻板印象来获取个人和组织利益。这些策略性表演往往受到当地同事和上级的鼓励。通过揭示外派人员如何从事刻板行为以提升结果，本研究将外国人身份重新构建为一种可以在情境和关系中加以表演的宝贵资产。这一视角提供了有价值的管理启示，并推进了对跨文化互动的理论理解。

papers.abstract_original: Affective polarization, a division marked by animosity between members of opposing political groups, has dramatically increased, particularly in the United States. This paper examines the extent to which affective polarization may spill over into organizations and influence strategic outcomes—specifically, corporate innovation. I theorize how politically balanced organizations, that is, those that lack a prevailing political ideology and have workforces that are more evenly divided between opposing political stances, are less innovative due to heightened animosity and reduced collaboration. Furthermore, I propose that the negative relationship between political balance and innovation intensifies at higher levels of partisan animosity in society and political engagement among organizational members. Conversely, I theorize that the relationship weakens when a firm is led by a CEO who does not overtly signal a clear political leaning. I test and find support for these predictions using a novel donation-based index of organizational political balance for 744 publicly traded U.S. companies from 2002 to 2015. This paper highlights the role of political balance as a potential conduit of intrafirm rivalry that hinders innovation. The findings advance our understanding of the mechanisms and conditions through which political polarization may influence organizations and their outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 情感极化——一种以对立政治群体成员之间敌意为标志的分裂——已急剧加剧，尤其是在美国。本文考察情感极化可能在多大程度上溢出到组织之中并影响战略结果——具体而言，即企业创新。我提出理论认为，政治上平衡的组织，即那些缺乏占主导地位的政治意识形态、其劳动力在对立政治立场之间分布更为均衡的组织，由于敌意加剧和协作减少而创新性更低。此外，我提出，政治平衡与创新之间的负向关系在社会中党派敌意水平更高以及组织成员政治参与程度更高时更为强烈。相反，我提出理论认为，当企业由一位不公开表明明确政治倾向的CEO领导时，这一关系会减弱。我使用一个基于捐赠的新颖组织政治平衡指数，对744家美国上市公司在2002年至2015年期间的情况检验了这些预测并找到了支持。本文凸显了政治平衡作为阻碍创新的企业内部竞争的潜在传导渠道的作用。这些发现推进了我们对政治极化可能影响组织及其结果的机制与条件的理解。
papers.title_original: Striking a Political Balance? Political Polarization and Firm Innovation
papers.title_zh: 实现政治平衡？政治极化与企业创新

papers.abstract_original: Whether more information available in capital markets fosters or hinders corporate innovation—and ultimately long-term firm value—remains a contentious question. Does enhanced transparency discipline managerial decision-making, or does it induce short-termism? This study addresses this tension by proposing that firms’ R&D capabilities critically moderate these opposing effects. Leveraging the European Union’s mandate for quarterly reporting as a quasi-natural experiment, we employ a difference-in-differences design to a panel of EU-listed manufacturing firms. We uncover a dual pathway: For firms with weaker R&D capabilities, greater transparency exerts a disciplining effect, leading to reduced R&D investment and enhancing firms’ value. Conversely, firms with stronger capabilities reallocate R&D toward more familiar domains to deliver quicker returns, consistent with a myopic response that limits exploration and undermines long-term value. Our findings contribute to management theory by unpacking how capital market pressures differentially affect the “whether” and “where” of innovation decisions and offer policymakers important insights into the unintended consequences of disclosure regulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 资本市场中更多可得信息究竟促进还是阻碍企业创新——并最终影响企业长期价值——仍是一个有争议的问题。透明度增强究竟会约束管理层的决策，还是会诱发短期主义？本研究通过提出企业的研发能力会关键性地调节这些相反效应来回应这一张力。我们利用欧盟对季度报告的强制要求作为准自然实验，对一组欧盟上市制造业企业采用双重差分设计。我们揭示了一条双重路径：对于研发能力较弱的企业，更高的透明度发挥约束效应，导致研发投资减少并提升企业价值。相反，对于能力较强的企业，它们会将研发重新配置到更熟悉的领域以带来更快的回报，这与一种限制探索并损害长期价值的短视反应相一致。我们的发现通过剖析资本市场压力如何差异化地影响创新决策的“是否”与“何处”，为管理理论作出贡献，并为政策制定者提供了关于披露监管意外后果的重要洞见。
papers.title_original: More Light but Less Sight? The Dual Effect of Information Transparency on Firm Innovation
papers.title_zh: 更多光亮却更少视野？信息透明度对企业创新的双重效应

papers.abstract_original: Although networking is critical for career advancement, prior research has primarily examined women’s networking in comparison to men’s, often concluding that it plays a less instrumental role due to gendered organizational structures. Women-only networking events are organized to enable women to leverage gender homophily for mutual support and career advancement. However, the mechanisms of gender homophily in women’s networking are not straightforward. Drawing on observations of women-only networking events, interviews, and secondary data, we identify three meanings women attach to homophilic networking (status-driven, instrumental, and expressive) and show how these meanings shape networking behaviors. In networking contexts characterized by “enforced homophily,” where support is offered under the guise of benevolence, women are more aware of these differences in meanings, which prevent them from leveraging the potential benefits of networking with other women. In contexts characterized by “agentic homophily,” the relevance of these differences is less salient, empowering women to challenge, rather than reproduce, gendered organizational structures. Our research extends the understanding of gender homophily as a multifaceted force that is dynamically shaped by the context and interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管社交网络对职业发展至关重要，但先前研究主要将女性的社交网络与男性的进行比较，并常常得出结论认为，由于性别化的组织结构，女性社交网络发挥的工具性作用较小。女性专属社交活动被组织起来，以使女性能够利用性别同质性来获得相互支持和职业发展。然而，性别同质性在女性社交网络中的机制并不简单。基于对女性专属社交活动的观察、访谈和二手数据，我们识别出女性赋予同质性社交网络的三种意义（地位驱动、工具性和表达性），并展示这些意义如何塑造社交网络行为。在以“强制同质性”为特征的社交网络情境中，支持是在善意的幌子下提供的，女性更意识到这些意义差异，这使她们无法利用与其他女性建立社交网络的潜在益处。在以“能动同质性”为特征的情境中，这些差异的相关性不那么显著，使女性能够挑战而非复制性别化的组织结构。我们的研究拓展了对性别同质性作为一种多面性力量的理解，这种力量由情境和互动动态塑造。

papers.abstract_original: Custodians are integral to institutional maintenance, and instrumental to preserving institutionally significant places. Yet when institutional decline impacts institutionally significant places, we do not know how custodians manage the tensions between preservation efforts aimed at saving these places and the need for adaptation. Using a rich qualitative dataset of interviews with custodians from and participant observation at 26 rural church buildings in England, we examine custodian responses when institutional decline in belief in Christian religion impacts sacred church buildings. We find that in response to experiencing place materiality, relational, and practices tensions, custodians are torn between preserving the institutional role of place and the need to find resources to maintain such places. Custodians manage these tensions by deliberatively evaluating materiality alterations and adopting innovative practices within the bounds of institutional appropriateness and resource constraints. The process we flesh out leads to distinct outcomes: place augmentation, practices augmentation, and, in a few instances, no augmentation. Our model portrays the pathways followed by institutional custodians that are rooted in the tensions they experience between the attachment to the institutional role of place and the need for change in response to institutional decline. Our study contributes to research on custodianship and place by uncovering divergent custodian responses when institutional decline impacts institutionally significant places and place as an institutional carrier and the locus of custodian place work.
papers.abstract_zh: 守护者是制度维持不可或缺的一部分，也是保护具有制度意义的地点的重要力量。然而，当制度衰退影响到具有制度意义的地点时，我们并不了解守护者如何管理旨在拯救这些地点的保护努力与适应需求之间的张力。我们使用一个丰富的定性数据集，其中包括对英格兰26座乡村教堂建筑的守护者的访谈以及对他们的参与式观察，考察当基督教信仰的制度衰退影响到神圣教堂建筑时守护者的反应。我们发现，在经历地点物质性、关系性和实践性张力时，守护者在对地点的制度角色的保护与寻找资源以维持此类地点的需求之间左右为难。守护者通过在制度适当性和资源约束的范围内审慎评估物质性改动并采用创新实践来管理这些张力。我们所阐明的过程导致不同的结果：地点增强、实践增强，以及在少数情况下没有增强。我们的模型描绘了制度守护者所遵循的路径，这些路径植根于他们在对地点制度角色的依恋与因应制度衰退而需要变革之间所经历的张力。我们的研究通过揭示当制度衰退影响到具有制度意义的地点时守护者的分化反应，以及地点作为制度载体和守护者地点工作的场所，为关于守护和地点的研究做出了贡献。
papers.title_original: Custodians at the Crossroads: Managing Change at Institutionally Significant Places
papers.title_zh: 十字路口的守护者：在具有制度意义的地点管理变革

papers.abstract_original: Interorganizational alliances have been extensively studied as strategic arrangements that enable firms to manage risks arising from their embeddedness in external relationships. However, the unique dynamics of business-to-government (B2G) relationships, where firms often face regulatory and political risks, remain underexplored. In this study, we examine how firms reliant on U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) contracts use strategic alliances to mitigate these challenges. Drawing on resource dependence theory and the resource-based view of the firm, we theorize that firms with higher government contract value are more likely to form alliances with other government contractors to help share risk and navigate government contracting challenges. We further identify two boundary conditions—an internal buffer (whether a firm operates as a generalist or specialist contractor) and an external buffer (the level of market-demand risk)—that moderate this relationship. Our analysis of 339 U.S. publicly traded DoD contractors from 2001 to 2019 provides robust support for our hypotheses. A post hoc mediation analysis further shows that alliances partially mediate the relationship between government contract value and market performance. Our study contributes to interorganizational relationships and business-government interface literatures by articulating the unique dynamics of B2G alliances and offering nuanced insights into how firms manage their relationships with powerful government buyers.
papers.abstract_zh: 组织间联盟已被广泛研究为一种战略安排，使企业能够管理因嵌入外部关系而产生的风险。然而，企业—政府（B2G）关系的独特动态——企业往往面临监管和政治风险——仍未得到充分探讨。在本研究中，我们考察依赖美国国防部（DoD）合同的企业如何利用战略联盟来缓解这些挑战。借鉴资源依赖理论和企业资源基础观，我们提出理论认为，政府合同价值较高的企业更可能与其他政府承包商组建联盟，以帮助分担风险并应对政府合同挑战。我们进一步识别出两个边界条件——一个内部缓冲（企业作为通才还是专家承包商运营）和一个外部缓冲（市场需求风险水平）——它们调节这一关系。我们对339家美国上市国防部承包商从2001年到2019年的分析为我们的假设提供了有力支持。一项事后中介分析进一步表明，联盟部分中介了政府合同价值与市场绩效之间的关系。我们的研究通过阐明B2G联盟的独特动态，并为企业如何管理与强大政府买方的关系提供细致见解，为组织间关系和企业—政府界面文献做出了贡献。

papers.abstract_original: Orchestrators shape ecosystem development by aligning diverse participants while advancing their own competitive agendas. This alignment becomes fragile when a new entrant offers an alternative value proposition that appeals to ecosystem participants but threatens an orchestrator’s position. Whereas prior research highlights the success of new entrants, less is known about how an orchestrator defends its competitive interests and position while addressing expectations of cooperation from ecosystem participants, which we call the “orchestrator’s dilemma.” We investigate these dynamics through a longitudinal study of Ericsson’s responses as Intel attempted to promote WiMAX as an alternative to LTE, Ericsson’s fourth-generation mobile technology. Our analysis shows how Ericsson recombined its substantive resource commitments and signaling tactics to develop three distinct strategic responses—avoiding competition, covert competition, and overt competition—as ecosystem support for the new entrant’s value proposition changed over time. We show how an orchestrator can defend its position against disruptive entrants by decoupling signaling tactics from substantive resource commitments to influence ecosystem dynamics. We contribute by theorizing these dynamic strategic responses as a way to overcome the orchestrator’s dilemma and by highlighting the social aspects of ecosystem alignment and its fragility.
papers.abstract_zh: 协调者通过协调多元参与者同时推进自身竞争议程来塑造生态系统的发展。当新进入者提供一种替代性价值主张，既吸引生态系统参与者又威胁协调者地位时，这种协调就变得脆弱。既有研究凸显了新进入者的成功，但对于协调者如何在应对生态系统参与者合作期望的同时捍卫其竞争利益和地位，我们知之甚少，我们将其称为“协调者的困境”。我们通过对爱立信应对英特尔试图推广WiMAX作为爱立信第四代移动技术LTE替代方案的过程进行纵向研究，考察了这些动态。我们的分析表明，随着生态系统对新进入者价值主张的支持随时间变化，爱立信如何重组其实质性资源承诺与信号策略，以发展出三种不同的战略回应——避免竞争、隐蔽竞争和公开竞争。我们展示了协调者如何通过将信号策略与实质性资源承诺脱钩来影响生态系统动态，从而捍卫其地位以对抗颠覆性进入者。我们的贡献在于将这些动态战略回应用以克服协调者困境进行了理论化，并凸显了生态系统协调的社会层面及其脆弱性。
papers.title_original: The Orchestrator’s Dilemma: How Ericsson Strategically Recombined Resource Commitments and Signaling Tactics to Outmaneuver WiMAX
papers.title_zh: 协调者的困境：爱立信如何战略性地重组资源承诺与信号策略以智胜WiMAX

papers.abstract_original: Overconfident CEOs are frequently criticized for making value-destroying corporate acquisitions in which they acquire excessively and overpay for their acquisitions. By contrast, we argue that overconfident CEOs can deliver higher returns in acquisition waves because the motivation and the requirement for action speed that occur in acquisition waves are different from other acquisition contexts. Specifically, we hypothesize and find that overconfident CEOs are more likely to capture preemption opportunities by acting earlier in acquisition waves, and such rapid moves enable overconfident CEOs to achieve higher acquisition returns. In addition, drawing upon organizational learning research, we hypothesize and find that in acquisition waves, pre-wave experience with large and related acquisitions facilitates overconfident CEOs to pursue acquisitions even more quickly during acquisition waves, which further enhances acquisition returns. Contributions to the acquisitions and CEO overconfidence literatures are discussed.
papers.abstract_zh: 过度自信的CEO经常因进行破坏价值的公司收购而受到批评，在这些收购中他们收购过多并为收购支付过高价格。相比之下，我们认为，过度自信的CEO能够在收购浪潮中带来更高回报，因为收购浪潮中出现的行动动机和对行动速度的要求不同于其他收购情境。具体而言，我们假设并发现，过度自信的CEO更有可能通过在收购浪潮中更早行动来抓住先占机会，而这种快速行动使过度自信的CEO能够实现更高的收购回报。此外，借鉴组织学习研究，我们假设并发现，在收购浪潮中，浪潮前拥有大规模和相关收购的经验有助于过度自信的CEO在收购浪潮期间更快地追求收购，这进一步提高了收购回报。本文讨论了对收购和CEO过度自信文献的贡献。
papers.title_original: When Overconfident CEOs Deliver Higher Returns: Evidence From Acquisition Waves
papers.title_zh: 当过度自信的CEO带来更高回报：来自收购浪潮的证据

papers.abstract_original: Individuals in impoverished communities often face considerable adversity. Under such circumstances, they can turn to illegal entrepreneurship. However, from a gendered perspective, women are typically considered incongruent with the masculinity of crime and entrepreneurship and, thus, illegal entrepreneurship. In this study, we were interested in exploring how women navigate their society’s gender role expectations to engage in illegal entrepreneurship. We adopted a qualitative, inductive approach to explore the cognitive processes through which women entrepreneurs navigate these tensions to manufacture and sell illegal alcohol within their impoverished communities throughout India. Our resulting gendered model of the cognitive processes underlying illegal entrepreneurship in impoverished communities offers new insights into how women entrepreneurs use cognitive carve-outs to navigate potentially conflicting societal expectations regarding gender and entrepreneurial roles. Further, we explore how entrepreneurship is influenced by construals, particularly in contexts of resource scarcity and gendered constraints. Finally, in line with the dark side of entrepreneurship, we shed light on how women can justify to themselves and others entrepreneurial action that, while shielding themselves from immediate personal repercussions, imposes substantial costs on many members of their impoverished communities.
papers.abstract_zh: 贫困社区中的个体常常面临相当大的逆境。在这种情况下，他们可能转向非法创业。然而，从性别化的视角来看，女性通常被认为与犯罪和创业的男性气质不相符，因而也与非法创业不相符。在本研究中，我们感兴趣的是探索女性如何应对其社会的性别角色期望以从事非法创业。我们采用定性、归纳式的方法，探索女性创业者如何在印度各地贫困社区中应对这些张力以制造和销售非法酒类的认知过程。我们由此得出的贫困社区非法创业认知过程的性别化模型，为女性创业者如何运用认知豁免来应对关于性别与创业角色的潜在冲突性社会期望提供了新见解。此外，我们探讨了创业如何受到解释框架的影响，尤其是在资源稀缺和性别化约束的情境中。最后，与创业的阴暗面相一致，我们揭示了女性如何向自己和他人正当化这样一种创业行动：它在使自身免受直接个人后果的同时，却给其贫困社区中的许多成员带来巨大代价。
papers.title_original: The Glass Is Half Full: A Gendered Model of Illegal Entrepreneurship
papers.title_zh: 杯子是半满的：一种性别化的非法创业模型

papers.abstract_original: Careers in creative crafts are perceived to be precarious: workers face constant rejection and receive low and erratic pay. Yet, some creative craft workers handle these challenges better than others. Precarity sometimes subsides as careers progress, and the core-periphery structure that typifies creative craft production systems is navigable. This raises the question of how creative craft workers can cope productively with the precarity of craft work. We research a prominent creative craft worker collective: country music songwriters. Our study captures the voices of 90 creative craft workers, drawing on secondary interviews with 66 songwriters working at the core of Nashville’s highly corporatized country music production system, and 24 operating at its social and spatial periphery. We find that the key to coping with precarity lies in achieving supportive patterns of social embeddedness by investing in primary craft skills, advancing higher-order vocational skills, and navigating the core-periphery structure of the creative craft production system. As apprentice songwriters practice their craft and learn how to organize their songwriting routines, they become increasingly vested in the system. Once they become master songwriters, they broaden their networks by liaising more with other industry stakeholders and engage with the system more reflexively to ensure their continued relevance. Peripheral workers engage in allyship and develop ties with workers positioned at the system’s core. We incorporate these social strategies in a grounded theoretical model capturing how songwriters cope with precarity. We conjecture that elements of the model generalize theoretically towards other corporatized creative craft production systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 创意手工艺领域的职业生涯被认为是不稳定的：从业者不断面临拒绝，并得到低且不稳定的报酬。然而，一些创意手工艺从业者比其他从业者更好地应对了这些挑战。随着职业生涯的推进，不稳定性有时会减弱，而作为创意手工艺生产系统典型特征的核心—边缘结构是可以被驾驭的。这提出了一个问题：创意手工艺从业者如何能够富有成效地应对手工艺工作的不稳定性。我们研究了一个著名的创意手工艺从业者群体：乡村音乐词曲作者。我们的研究捕捉了90名创意手工艺从业者的声音，借鉴了对在纳什维尔高度公司化的乡村音乐生产系统核心工作的66名词曲作者，以及在其社会与空间边缘运作的24名词曲作者的二手访谈。我们发现，应对不稳定性的关键在于通过投资于初级手工艺技能、提升更高阶的职业技能，以及驾驭创意手工艺生产系统的核心—边缘结构，来实现支持性的社会嵌入模式。当学徒词曲作者练习其手艺并学习如何组织其词曲创作日常时，他们日益投身于该系统之中。一旦他们成为大师级词曲作者，他们便通过更多地与其他行业利益相关者联络来拓宽其网络，并更具反思性地参与该系统，以确保其持续的相关性。边缘从业者参与结盟，并与处于系统核心位置的从业者建立联系。我们将这些社会策略纳入一个扎根理论模型，以捕捉词曲作者如何应对不稳定性。我们推测，该模型的要素在理论上可推广至其他公司化的创意手工艺生产系统。
